THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics and Critical Review

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to interpret standard errors, p values, statistical power and confidence intervals in research for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Calculate the standard error of the mean as the standard deviation divided by the square root of n.
  2. Define the null hypothesis and the p value, and recognise common misinterpretations of p values.
  3. Define type I (alpha) and type II (beta) errors and power (1 minus beta), and list four factors that determine sample size.
  4. Calculate a 95% confidence interval as the estimate plus or minus 1.96 standard errors.
  5. Interpret significance from a confidence interval: a ratio interval crossing 1, or a difference interval crossing 0, is not significant.
  6. Explain why confidence intervals give more information than p values, including precision and clinical importance.
  7. Answer the chapter's 71 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
